newsitem.title: USA: Phillips says Sweeny, Tx. refinery back to normal.
newsitem.headline: Phillips says Sweeny, Tx. refinery back to normal.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co brought its 205,000 barrel per day refinery in Sweeny, Texas back to normal operation levels over the Memorial Day weekend, according to the company.

The refinery had been shut May 13 when a power outage hit the area, and the restart of the facility took slightly longer than originally expected. The company had hoped to return the facility to normal operation by May 22.
((-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620))
